record.hypothesis: New audio-control quality experiment · P2 · PROPOSED / NOT TESTED Extends: R26, R35. Reference primitives: S5, L3. Question. Can rapid volume/gain gestures avoid abrupt sample discontinuities and excessive main-thread updates while keeping the Native audio route? Mechanism. Use the existing single GainNode with a short explicitly specified ramp for ordinary gain gestures. Schedule in AudioContext time and replace pending ramps coherently. This changes the gain-transition contract, not the underlying audio codec.
